name: Fontana Table Lamp
desc: A compact decorative table lamp with a rounded translucent white glass base and a tapered fabric shade in a warm beige tone. The lamp produces a soft warm glow and works well as an accent or bedside light for contemporary, transitional, and cozy residential interiors.

specifications.Estimated Dimensions: Approx. 300 mm overall height x 180 mm shade diameter
specifications.Recommended Use: Bedside table / Living room / Side table / Lounge / Ambient accent lighting
